title: DAY 20/90
VIBRATIONS
scenes.sub: New subject: free vibration starts today
scenes.voice: Day twenty of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty eight days to go! A new subject begins today: vibrations. Let's get the basics locked in.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is vibrations. Our topic: free vibration of single degree of freedom systems, with and without damping.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover natural frequency, equivalent springs in series and parallel, the damping ratio and its three cases, and the logarithmic decrement.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Log decrement is the natural log of two successive amplitudes: two pi zeta over root of one minus zeta squared. Light damping? Just use two pi zeta.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Solve the free practice PDF on Telegram first. Then take tonight's test, seven to nine P. M., in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 19 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day nineteen toppers! Kunal climbs to rank one with twenty six out of thirty. Sweta Rani Sahoo takes rank two, and Rahul Yadav rank three. Brilliant work!
